desc:
Practice the trauma inducing towers in Eternal Towers of Hell, ranging all the way from "intense" to "catastrophic" difficulty!
(https://www.roblox.com/games/8562822414/Eternal-Towers-of-Hell)

AS OF 3/12/2025: This place is no longer supported and will likely not be receiving future updates. Most towers should still be playable, but not all of them.
AS OF 18/7/2026: This place will soon start being maintained again, various updates are planned.

Note: Certain towers will be excluded from this game due to several factors, such as complexities with inserting them here along with their low difficulty and lack of punishment that make practice unnecessary. The following towers so far are:
-CoHaD
-ToO
-ToTUTU
